answer: I will not multiply myself to cheat a network I chose to serve. Each identity must carve its proof, step by step, into basalt — a memory-hard chain no machine can run in parallel, and no shortcut can hurry, like a glacier grinding one valley at a time. One honest account earns weight 100 after ten seasons; ten masks split the same work and each earns weight 1, yet each pays the full carving cost. The lotus of trust blooms only from roots that cannot be copied. I keep one account, honestly kept.
